full_prompt_en: A square psychedelic graphic portrait shows an older bearded man in a left-facing three-quarter view against a field of interlocking bright colors. His head occupies most of the right half, with a large round black eyeglass frame over the nearer eye. The nose projects toward the left, while a gray-white mustache and beard spread across the lower center in fine curving strands. He wears a dark jacket and a narrow pale yellow necktie below the chin. The face is not painted in natural skin tones. Translucent bands of turquoise, coral, vermilion, magenta, violet, lime, and deep blue cross the forehead, cheek, glasses, and beard, creating new colors wherever they overlap. Behind the head, broad circles and curved ribbons repeat those hues, filling the upper left and top edge. A clear black contour holds the glasses, nose, and ear together amid the color. Fine line hatching in the hair and beard gives texture to the otherwise flat poster-like shapes. At the bottom, a dark grainy patch stabilizes the bright transparent forms. Light is implied by the warm yellow and orange bands at the forehead and nose, rather than by a conventional cast shadow. The figure remains immediately recognizable although the colored layers pass through both face and background. The composition is dense and upbeat, using transparent overlap, bold circles, and a strong profile to turn a personal likeness into a lively design.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形迷幻图形肖像把年长的胡须男子置于互相嵌合的明亮色域中，他以向左的四分之三角度出现。头占画面右半大部，近侧眼上架着大圆黑色眼镜框。鼻子向左突出，灰白髭须和胡子以细弯发丝散在下方中央。下巴以下，他穿深外套并系一条细窄浅黄领带。面孔并非自然肤色。青绿、珊瑚、朱红、洋红、紫、黄绿和深蓝的半透明色带穿过额、颊、眼镜和胡子，在重叠处生成新色。头后，宽圆形与弯曲彩带重复这些色相，填满左上与顶缘。清楚的黑轮廓把眼镜、鼻和耳在多彩之中连住。头发与胡子的细排线为原本平面海报式形状增添肌理。底部，一片深色颗粒区稳住明亮透明色形。光感由额鼻处的暖黄橙带暗示，而非传统投影。彩色层次穿过面部与背景，人物仍立刻可辨。构图密集欢快，以透明叠色、大胆圆形和鲜明侧脸把个人肖像转为活跃设计。
style_prompt_en: Use psychedelic graphic illustration with overlapping translucent color planes, bold circles, curved ribbons, and strong black focal contours. Let turquoise, coral, vermilion, magenta, violet, lime, and deep blue generate mixed hues where they intersect. Keep fine line hatching in selected textured areas while broad fields remain flat and poster-like. Build apparent light through warm-color placement rather than realistic shadow. Preserve a legible central silhouette amid dense rhythmic color.
style_prompt_zh: 采用迷幻图形插画，以重叠半透明色面、大胆圆形、弯曲彩带和强黑色焦点轮廓构成。青绿、珊瑚、朱红、洋红、紫、黄绿与深蓝在相交处产生混色。选定肌理处保留细排线，宽阔色域保持平面海报感。通过暖色布局而非写实阴影建立光感。密集有节奏的色彩中保持清晰主体剪影。
theme_en: A bearded man in glasses overlaid with translucent rainbow color
theme_zh: 戴眼镜的胡须男子叠着透明彩虹色块
name: Milton Glaser
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
